items.title: What Could Workday (WDAY) Gain From Its AI Deal And EU Cloud Safeguards?
items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS: WDAY) plans to acquire Honeydew, a semantic layer for AI and business intelligence, to plug into its Workday Data Cloud. The Honeydew deal is intended to support governed business intelligence and autonomous agents across Workday's finance and HR applications. Workday also introduced new operational safeguards for its EU Sovereign Cloud that address European data sovereignty and governance requirements.
